title: LocalStorage and IndexedDB
description: Practice localstorage and indexeddb through a self-contained HTML browser interaction, a failing starter, a corrected solution and repeatable regression checks.
objectives: Explain localstorage and indexeddb in real browser state and semantics
Repair the broken DOM interaction without unsafe HTML insertion
Verify the interaction via local Node assertions and Chromium behavioral checks

sources.label: Official browser API or accessibility reference

rubric: I can reproduce the original localstorage and indexeddb failure.
I can explain the DOM state and keyboard semantics of the repair.
I validate the page in a real browser, not only through source-text checks.
